kind.description: One of the Warning kinds; callers ignore unknown values.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Not part of the contract.

paths.description: Filesystem paths involved; meaning per kind (see Warning kinds).

ids.description: Task IDs involved; order and meaning per kind (see Warning kinds).

reason.description: For unusable-file: unreadable, corrupt, or unsupported-format.

code.description: Symbolic OS error (e.g. EACCES), for unusable-file with reason unreadable, unreadable-folder, and notes-missing (absent there when the OS error has no symbolic name).
